acceptance: The bypass-test allowlist contains only documented parse-only uses with reasons.
Each PR includes a corpus diff over the area's existing inputs and states any behavior change (read dialect, quoting).
Per-area unit tests pass; make pr-preflight, make comment-policy-check, make compat-docs-check, make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check and make typecheck pass on each head.
description: About 20 modules call the vendored SQLGlot directly (tpcdi loader/queries/schema, tpcds c_tools, flightdata queries, tpcds_obt query_conversion, read_primitives variant_contracts, etl scd_processor, schema, validation, scripts/generate_query_docs.py and others). Migrate them to translate_sql_query in three PRs (TPC-DI; TPC-DS/OBT/FlightData/read_primitives; schema/validation/etl/scripts), using scope='schema_ddl' for DDL as tpcds_obt does. translate_ddl and apply_rewrite arrive in later adoptions, so this item must not use them. TPC-DI reads read='ansi', which the fork's Dialects enum lacks: through the wrapper it may start translating where it previously fell back to the original query, so each PR carries a corpus diff and passes identify explicitly. Parse-only callers may stay, listed with a reason in the bypass-test allowlist.
